name: Pre-Run Dynamic Warm-Up
description: Dynamic movement before running. Start easy; avoid long static holds.

name: Tight Hamstrings: Mobility & Strength
description: Gentle mobility plus strengthening. Do not force a stretch or reproduce nerve symptoms.

name: Piriformis & Sciatic Symptom Care
description: Gentle options only. Avoid deep stretching if symptoms radiate.

name: After Run: Cooldown & Recovery
description: Walk until breathing settles, then use comfortable calf, hip-flexor and hamstring mobility. Skip anything that increases radiating symptoms.

name: Rest Day: Gentle Mobility
description: Low-intensity mobility, pelvic control, and easy activation. No forced stretching or painful nerve tension.

name: Running Day: Warm-Up + Recovery
description: Combined pre-run and post-run sequence. Complete the dynamic warm-up before running; return to the remaining cooldown exercises afterward.
